title: Episode 1
overview: Mikura, a skilled mercenary working for the Danger Service Agency, becomes involved in a dangerous kidnapping case tied to a powerful crime syndicate. After a violent confrontation, she is forced into a tense arrangement with the gang’s ruthless leader while uncovering a larger conspiracy.

title: Episode 2
overview: As the conflict escalates, Mikura and her teammates fight to rescue a kidnapped girl and expose the syndicate’s operations. The mission culminates in an explosive showdown that tests Mikura’s loyalty, endurance, and combat skills.
